Agent Name: Historian
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Historian agent made a factual error by claiming that Julia, the daughter of Cornelia and Julius Caesar, was married to Tiberius. In reality, Julia married Tiberius' nephew, Gaius Claudius Marcellus (and later Gaius Scribonius Curio), not Tiberius himself. Tiberius was the son of Augustus and Livia, and he married Julia's sister, Vipsania Agrippina (or rather, Julia married Gaius Claudius Marcellus, and later Gaius Scribonius Curio; Tiberius was married to Vipsania Agrippina, daughter of Marcus Vipsanius Agrippa). This false premise led to the incorrect conclusion that Tiberius was Cornelia's child-in-law.
